purpose: Expose useful structural analogies for Arcsweep design without asserting that Arcsweep implements Steins;Gate physics or importing fictional mechanics as empirical claims.

mappings.use: Treat a state as a complete internally consistent history rather than a bag of edited fields.
Measure how far a candidate lineage departs from a reference state while keeping the metric implementation explicit.
Detect when many different trajectories repeatedly terminate in the same structural outcome.
Separate changes that alter surface circumstances from changes that move the system into a genuinely different basin.
Preserve provenance-aware memory of prior accepted states when the active state changes.
Give the operator a readable measurement rather than hiding state change behind prose.
Ask which observations/invariants must remain while changing the causal path that produced them.
Useful comparison for persona provenance, memory capture, and the distinction between a person/model and a stored representation of their memory/personality.

guardrails: This file is not part of Steins;Gate canon.
Analogies do not establish physical equivalence.
Canon records remain unchanged if an Arcsweep mapping is revised.
